dashboards.description: This is part of 2 dashboards that cover vSAN Performance. This focuses on the contention. Contention is the primary counter for performance, while utilization is the secondary counter. It lists all the vSAN clusters with their contention metrics. Select a cluster, and its detail contention over time will be automatically shown. Use this in conjunction with the vSphere Cluster performance dashboards, as these focus on non vSAN parts.
